verdicts.title: Extension of the past lifetime and its connection to the cumulative entropy
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given two absolutely continuous nonnegative independent random variables, we define the reversed relevation transform as dual to the relevation transform. We first apply such transforms to the lifetimes of the components of parallel and series systems under suitably proportionality assumptions on the hazards rates. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses cumulative entropy in the context of reliability theory, reversed relevation transforms, and lifetimes of system components — it has no bearing on resolution proof complexity, Tseitin formulas, or width/weight scaling exponents in clause sequences.
